messages:
Noah (eng): Ten minutes to go. Quick run: streaming to RTMP + Zoom. Minor agenda change: move the product metrics block to the end.
Priya (prod): Leadership requested a 3-min clarification after roadmap for Dedicated pricing tiers. Please trim demo by 3.
Lina (infra): Caption service showed increased latency earlier (20% token lag). I moved the worker pool to the hot node, should be stable now.
Tomas (comm): Can we enable live poll at the end? I'll prepare the Slido link. Also need final speaker names with pronouns for the post.
Zoe (design): Updated deck uploaded (no auto-transitions) and added slide notes for captions. Link: drive.company/allhands/2023/slides_v3.pptx
Noah (eng): AV vendor on standby. If RTMP buffer grows >30s, switch to recording-only mode and announce. Fallback RTMP toggle cmd (on stream host):
```
systemctl stop streamproxy && systemctl start recorder
```
That stops the live push but keeps recording.
Lina (infra): For quick obs restart (if camera feed dies):
```
pkill -9 obs || true
systemctl restart v4l2loopback
obs --startrecording --minimize-to-tray &
```
Tested on canary. Expect ~12s gap.
Priya (prod): Where should people drop follow-ups? We'll use the GDoc for tracked asks, but drop urgent live follow-ups here. I'll collate and tag leadership.
Tomas (comm): I'll post speaker roster + Slido 30s before start. Also coordinating caption language set to `en-US`.
Zoe (design): Small note: presenters, please avoid screen-share transitions during the metrics slide to prevent encoder spikes.
Noah (eng): Monitor network at :45s into the stream (we saw a small spike before). Lina, can you watch netstat?
Lina (infra): Watching now: `watch -n1 ss -s` and tailing stream logs: `tail -f /var/log/stream/*.log | grep -i rtmp`
allhands-bot: Recording queued; meeting link: https://zoom.company/all-hands. Recording will start in 2 minutes.
Priya (prod): Thanks team. I'll keep the Q&A gating simple: 2 leadership questions prioritized.
Tomas (comm): Posting links in #general and will pin the recording post after.
Noah (eng): Good luck everyone. Ping here only if an AV/blocker pops.
